title: TrainStation 3: Journey of Steel tests your train tycoon tactics with a serious supply setback
summary: In any tycoon sim, there's something inherently satisfying about watching everything fall into place after all your hard work. But keeping everything running smoothly is a challenge in itself, as one bottleneck can have a knock-on effect across your entire operation – and that's exactly what you'll be tackling in TrainStation 3: Journey of Steel's latest Lumber Jam event! As you might expect, Pixel Federation's limited-time challenge will have you trying to untangle a tangled mess across the railroad tycoon's supply chain, identifying the weakest link and pushing you to test your logistical prowess. To make sure you control the reins on the railway, you'll need to hone your resource management skills too - thankfully, you've got plenty of factory upgrades to aim for to keep your Scandinavian supply run on track. ... [MORE]

title: G-Star Korea 2026 and G-Con set to showcase the best of Korea's games industry
summary: While we don't usually cover conferences in great detail, there are a few exceptions. The likes of Gamescom, of course, flash up on our radar, and occasionally we get to hit up other exciting shows. But one we've had our eye on recently is the G-Star 2026 event in South Korea. Hosted every year, G-Star offers a glimpse into the games industry of one of the biggest spots for mobile on the planet. And even if that's not your cup of tea, there's exciting behind-the-scenes discussions at G-Con that'll fascinate even the most sceptical gamer. Talks such as Shift Up's Kim Hyung-tae and Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami in conversation, or an entire session devoted to Final Fantasy VII's influence on JRPGs make this a mecca for gaming fans. ... [MORE]

title: UnGodly brings brutal hack 'n slash action to mobile in the fine Frazetta tradition, out now
summary: Time to put aside flashy, colourful martial arts moves and get right to the hacking and slashing, as UnGodly, the brutal new fantasy RPG from Mark Otero (one of the key people behind Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes), lands today on iOS and Android. Set in the world of Dunmiir, a world ravaged by The Devouring, you play as gifted warriors called Primals who offer the only hope to defy fate and save the world. To do so, you'll need to hack 'n slash your way through foes big and small, wielding crude but effective weaponry, the power of magic and more. Think Diablo, but with a touch of Genshin and a sprinkle of Frazetta's famous paintings to wrap the world together. ... [MORE]

title: Plants Vs Zombies: Replanted set to land on Apple Arcade with new Party Mode
summary: Out of the cornerstone mobile game series out there, Plants Vs Zombies has occupied a special place in the hearts of many players. With so many fans devoted to the series, I'm sure there's more than a few of you who'll be excited to learn that Plants Vs Zombies: Replanted is coming to mobile, exclusively via Apple Arcade! Plants Vs Zombies: Replanted reinvents and remasters the hit 2009 original, with widescreen support, hi-res art and a variety of quality-of-life features to boot. Basically, it's all you loved about the original, as you battle to defend your lawn from hordes of invading zombies with your trusty plants, just brought up to modern standards! ... [MORE]

title: Resident Evil Survival Unit celebrates first anniversary with the addition of Albert Wesker
summary: Resident Evil Survival Unit, the mobile adaptation of Capcom's hit zombie-survival franchise developed by Aniplex and JoyCity, is celebrating over a year of service. And to mark the event, we're not only getting a major new update, but also the addition of everyone's favourite geographically ambiguous villain, Albert Wesker. Wesker debuts as part of Ruins, a dungeon-like mechanic that pits you against various famous villains from the Resi franchise, interacting with them as you complete missions to thwart their plans. Fortunately, at your beck and call, you'll have the Resident Evil 4 versions of Leon Kennedy and Ada Wong joining the fight as part of this update too! ... [MORE]

title: Angry Birds Dream Blast takes you back to the Angry Birds Movie 2 in new event
summary: With the Angry Birds Movie 3 set to land in cinemas soon, it's no surprise that Rovio are eager to get people back in the silver screen mood. And now Angry Birds Dream Blast is throwing you back to the original sequel, with a new in-game event devoted to the Angry Birds Movie 2. The event will see you play through content inspired by the Angry Birds Movie 2 and relive the events of the film for yourself. It also sees the introduction of the Dream Album mechanic, which lets you earn even more rewards themed around the film for completing levels. All in all, a great way to prep yourself for the new film with the new Dream Album available for the next 28 days. ... [MORE]

title: Delta Force has you dodging riptides and throwing shields in their newest season, Aurora
summary: Delta Force, Timi Studio Group and Team Jade's popular tactical shooter, is getting a major suite of new content today. The launch of Delta Force's latest update, Season Aurora, comes packed with a new operator, map and plenty of quality-of-life fixes, which means you'll definitely want to log in and have a go! title: Gobs & Gears turns factory building into a goblin-powered demolition puzzle
summary: The best advice Gobs & Gears gives you is to build it wrong. It may sound counterintuitive, but you lay out a route, rip it up the moment it’s done its job, and blow up the odd building along the way, all to finish a bomb for a goblin king who wants it immediately. It’s a logistics puzzler that’s out now on iPhone. The map starts under a thick Fog. Just like London has been the past few days. You put up Scout Towers to burn it back in bursts, and each surge reveals lost Buildings that need to be brought back. For that, you need the right resources, which must be hauled around by Trundlers along conveyor routes you lay yourself. And if a mountain gets in your way, just blow it up. ... [MORE]

title: Hillthorn, the card-based detective sim, is out now on iOS and Android
summary: Even if Halloween is done and dusted, the November nights are drawing in, making it perfect for something spooky to play. And if that's the mood that's taking you, then publisher Raw Fury and developer Fool Moon's latest release that's just landed for iOS and Android, Hillthorn, should be more than enough in the way of chills and thrills. summary: Of all the upcoming Tencent releases, I think one of the strangest has been Fizzglee's  Chasing Kaleidorider. Described as a doki doki romance, it'd be easy to dismiss it as just another dumb waifu game. title: Warhammer Survivors sees the grimdark future take on the Vampire Survivors formula, out now
summary: With Warhammer having gone from a niche tabletop board game to a bona fide cultural phenomenon, that popularity also brings dozens of video game spinoffs. But Auroch Digital aren't going the shooter or strategy route, as today their long-awaited collaboration with Poncle lands on iOS and Android, as Warhammer Survivors launches for mobile! Warhammer Survivors sees the Vampire Survivors format translated both to the universe of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar. As iconic characters from both series, you'll fight your way through hordes of enemies, across a variety of stages, and take on powerful bosses with increasingly ludicrous, game-changing weaponry of your own. ... title: Kettle Street sends you searching for a missing cat in its new Missing Abra event
summary: Where’s Wally (Waldo, if you grew up in the US) only works because everyone’s staring at the same page, so someone can point and the rest of you can pretend you’d nearly got there. Kettle Street, the cosy British life sim, is taking a page out of that book for their latest event, Missing Abra. Claire’s calico cat has gone missing somewhere in town, and you need to help find it. You find her by wandering Kettleby, and once you spot her, you take a photo with a new camera. She hides somewhere different in each person’s town, though. A mate who found her yesterday can’t tell you where yours is, and neither can we. No guides will help with this one. ... [MORE]

TalesWeaver originally launched in 2003 as an online RPG, a genre that was extremely popular in Korea and that gave rise to other hits such as MapleStory. This new spinoff takes you back to the world first outlined in Jeon Min-hee's novel Children of the Rune, with the familiar mix of fantastical world and colourful graphics. ... [MORE]

title: Temppal: Overgeared is the new 3D MMORPG from Nexon that could soon come West
summary: Overseas launches can often provide us with an exciting glimpse of some upcoming potential hits. And that's certainly true when it comes to Nexon, a publisher with plenty under their belts. Their latest major release is Temppal: Overgeared, a 3D MMORPG based on the hit Webtoon of the same name! Releasing November 26th for Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, Temppal: Overgeared is based on the series of the same name. Following MMO player Shin Youngwoo, it's a typical rags-to-riches video game story, where Shin stumbles upon a rare class ability that turns him into a legendary crafter, with all the trouble that brings. ... [MORE]

title: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble doesn't make the grade and is set to be shut down
summary: Well, unfortunately, I think we all knew it was a strong possibility, but Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble, the PvP arena shooter spinoff of the hit PlayStation property, is officially cancelled. Service is set to end on May 1st 2027, with the game being delisted from stores on November 21st, with one final update to enjoy. Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble was a hero-style arena shooter, where you'd step into the shoes of new and existing characters from across the universe of Ratchet & Clank, duking it out in a combat simulation hosted by Captain Qwark to discover the next generation of Galactic Rangers. ... [MORE]

title: MapleStory: Idle continues to celebrate its first anniversary with new classes and events
summary: When it comes to overseas MMOs, MapleStory is one which is massively popular in its native Korea, but which until now hasn't really cut through with a mainstream Western audience. But MapleStory: Idle RPG has been one of Nexon's first steps into a game with global appeal, and is continuing its first anniversary celebrations! As you might expect, MapleStory: Idle RPG's celebratory first anniversary events include plenty of new ways to upgrade your character. Whether that's the 1st Anniversary Salon Special Mission, Salon Ring Workshop or Anniversary Shop, through to December 16th you'll be able to nab plenty of new rewards and growth material. ... [MORE]
